method: Chromium browser checks used visible test controls to exercise production rendering and final release CSS, followed by read-only layout measurements and visual inspection. Test controls are excluded from the production release.

correctedRegression.description: The first wrapping candidate produced an 8px overlap between result panel and toolbar. Final measured clearance restores an 8px gap without changing the terrain text size or toolbar controls.

limitations: Exact-width iframe rendering, not physical-device emulation.
GRAVITY SDK transport, real user identity and real iOS safe-area behavior were not exercised.
Host top and bottom insets were explicitly simulated.
Short-screen BET retains its existing internal scrolling; Confirm is reachable rather than always initially visible.
No private input image or screenshots are included in this proof.
